subject: Handoff matrix & pricing alignment for MSA/DPA sequencing
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@medalign.co>, Samir Patel <samir.p@novamed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff matrix & pricing alignment for MSA/DPA sequencing

Hi Lena / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Per our conversation, the procurement and legal teams asked for a clear mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the sequence for MSA / DPA / Order Form sign-off and the acceptance gates for the pilot. To make the procurement review efficient, we've sketched an initial handoff matrix that ties pricing milestones to legal deliverables (see attached).

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm which stakeholders must sign the DPA vs order form (legal vs procurement).
- Identify any escrow/escrow-like controls required by NovaMed (we heard possible concerns on data residency).
- Preferred signature window (2-week review / 1-week signature vs longer).

I've looped Jordan for pricing and Grace for acceptance criteria alignment on our side. I propose we lock a tentative close timeline w/ two sign windows in July: an expedited window (July 18–25) and a standard window (Aug 1–10). Can you confirm which lane your team prefers?

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + handoff matrix)

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lena Park <lena@medalign.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@novamed.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff matrix & pricing alignment for MSA/DPA sequencing

Hi Neha —

Appreciate the file. Quick responses from procurement/legal side:
- For NovaMed: DPA needs legal sign-off; order form is a procurement+finance signature. Expect separate routing.
- Data residency: procurement flagged a requirement for EU-processed backups for patient-sourced data — they want the DPA clause spelling this out.
- Signature window: procurement prefers the standard window (Aug 1–10) given month-end reviews; legal may do an accelerated review if we can supply a redline and a clear evidence bundle (SOC2 report and sample audit log exports).

Action items from our side: we'll deliver a prioritized question list by Tue 29 Jun. If Redwood can provide a DPA redline and an acceptance checklist (what constitutes pilot success) by Mon 28 Jun, our legal will prioritize the accelerated path.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Procurement (MedAlign Programs)
lena@medalign.co
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Handoff matrix & pricing alignment for MSA/DPA sequencing

Jordan / Grace —

Forwarding Lena's note. Procurement will push for the Aug 1–10 window unless we surface the redline + acceptance checklist quickly. Jordan: can you confirm whether pricing needs an order-form amendment for the pilot (we have two pricing lanes; one has a usage cap that legal flagged as needing explicit language). Grace: can you draft a 1-page acceptance checklist that maps to the MAP milestones (pilot success criteria, data export/retention, performance SLOs)?

I'll aim to send the DPA redline by EOD Mon; if not, earliest Tue morning. If we get both artifacts into their inbox by Tue 29 Jun, Lena said legal will try the accelerated review.

Neha

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@medalign.co>, Samir Patel <samir.p@novamed.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff matrix & pricing alignment for MSA/DPA sequencing

Hi all —

Thanks for the clarity, Lena. Quick update from pricing/legal side at Redwood: we've attached a DPA redline (Draft_MSA_redline.pdf) and a one-page acceptance checklist in the MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, tab: Acceptance_Checklist). Highlights:
- Pricing: pilot remains on lane A (flat monthly + usage topping with a soft cap). We will add explicit order form language to surface overage handling during the pilot (no surprise invoices).
- Data residency: we can add an EU-processed backups clause for patient-sourced datasets; will show the exact clause in the DPA redline.
- Evidence: SOC2 type II report (rolling 12 months) and an export sample will be uploaded to the Drive link shared below.

Proposed next steps:
1) We push the DPA redline and acceptance checklist into your legal by EOD Wed (30 Jun).
2) Procurement confirms preferred signature window after reviewing redline; if they still want Aug 1–10 we'll align that as primary and keep July 18–25 as fallback.
3) If legal signs off on the redline with minor comments, we can aim for an executed order form by Aug 8 (mid-window).

Drive evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPfolder
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-4821

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
